title: V:ølet strikes with a dark pop slide into chaos “break it down”
htmlContent: Emerging from the shadows, the artist known as v:ølet, formerly Raven Ives, has released her second song, “break it down.” This new track is a captivating journey into the world of dark pop and is her first release of 2025, following her earlier track, “just drive.” It sets the stage for more music to come. “break it down” expertly balances dreamy and intense elements, drawing listeners in with its atmospheric sounds before bursting into powerful moments. v:ølet’s voice shifts from haunting whispers to heartfelt confessions, creating a sense of urgency that feels personal and overwhelming. The music features rich layers of synths and deep sounds, establishing her unique style and showing that she is making her mark in the world of dramatic music. https://open.spotify.com/track/2advBFPGcbRgWaiE1gV1I7?si=g9n60TKRRsmoy1gSrmanow This track unfolds like a storm building, showcasing beauty and chaos that you can’t help but notice. With more singles on the way and hints of an upcoming EP or album, v:ølet shows that she’s changing her artistic identity and pushing the boundaries of her sound. Follow on: Instagram
